scope: Recover a current explicit complete citizenship clause as hotel-search guest_nationality, never infer passports from geography, language or history.

helper.reference: Pinned RU/EN CLDR249-country labels/forms and uppercase ISO-2; exact complete value, no fuzzy country guessing.
helper.personal_clause_scope: Exactly one canonical traveler, who is an adult, after the grounded proposed operations.
helper.group_scope: Only an explicit instruction such as Для поиска отеля используй гражданство Россия. No individual traveler passport attributes are created.
no_inference_from: one adult's passport when children or other adults are present
helper.model_contradiction: Human conflict, original model operations preserved for audit; no silent overwrite.
helper.same_saved_or_same_model_country: No extra operation or fake revision.
helper.parent_hook: After normal intent grounding and room-count grounding, before group separation/final validation; only CHANGE/no conflicts. Parent owns Harness integration.

verified: Country -> city query -> explicit homonym choice is reached through ordinary public API messages.
The exact unchanged five actual model operations pass through the current real Harness/Store.
The parent hook adds only RU, preserving origin/adult/group/owned world city and refs/dates/room/budget.
No repeated nationality question remains; MODEL_OPERATIONS_CHECKED records the recovery normalization.
Travel source methods deliberately return controlled CONFIG_MISSING. State survives, but no ready plan/order is claimed.

initial_test_setup_failures_preserved.cause: Unit setup bypassed the required owned-place intent grounding and tried to create a legacy language preference through a currently unsupported public setter. Fixtures were corrected to the real hook input and a declared old Preference DTO; country/consent assertions were not relaxed.

limits: This is a literal omission fallback, not general passport extraction or a permission filter for every existing model nationality operation.
Complete raw model operations must undergo normal intent grounding before this helper; it does not repair invalid room/city/group batches.
A successful controlled source-error retention test is not actual hotel availability, world trip readiness or new inference.
A separate immutable actual R3 run is required before claiming the new conversational path accepted.
